name: ctao_sii_stage2
label: CTAO-SII Stage II (1 nm x 10 channels, dedicated photodetectors, > 2 GHz)
sources: Biteau 2026-10-08, 'Stellar intensity interferometry with the CTAO' (La Palma), Stage I / Stage II table (slides 15-16, T. Hassan): Stage II QE 0.45, > 2 GHz, F 1.05, 1 nm bandpass, 10 channels; dedicated photodetectors, focal-plane corrective optics; S/N proportional to sqrt(N_baselines N_channels)
notes: alpha is fixed by the backend (dedicated photodetectors replace the camera PMTs); q still per telescope (0.64 / 0.73).
assumptions: lambda 425 nm (the Stage II band is not stated)
